caption:
Comment HOOKS and I'll send you the swipe file — all six first-line shapes with worked examples.

The first line is about 80% of whether a post works. Everything after it is delivery.

The six shapes that keep showing up:

1. Negate — "Nobody needs ___. They need ___."
2. Correct — "Most people think ___."
3. Binary — "___ ❌  ___ ✅"
4. Without — "How to ___ without ___."
5. Reframe — "Your ___ isn't ___ — it's ___."
6. Count — "The ___ things I actually reuse."

Two rules that matter more than the shape.

Five to eight words. Past ten it shrinks on screen, and that is the exact moment it stops landing.

Lead with the ending. The sentence you were saving for last is the one that earns the swipe.

Write the line before you write the post. If the line is flat, the post was never going to save you.

Comment HOOKS for the swipe file.
